question: What preparatory consecration must precede the performance of the fire offering?
premises: The fire pits are the objects of preparation.
The fire offering follows these purifications.
inference: After performing the five purifications on the fire pits, one should perform the fire offering.
uncertainties: The specific five purifications are not enumerated here.
plain_english: Having performed the five purifications on the fire pits, one should carry out the fire offering.
